name: verification-before-completion

summary.en: Superpowers’ rule that the agent must run verification commands and read their output before claiming work is done.
summary.zh: Superpowers 的规则：Agent 在宣称完成之前，必须运行验证命令并读取输出。

upstreamDescription: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
